messages:
Kevin: Quick heads-up — emergency rollforward fix landed in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5102. This unblocks customers seeing cache eviction NPEs in 2.3.1. We have until 15:30 UTC to merge into release branch. Policy: requires two reviewer approvals + green CI. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex: I'm jumping on this now, will prioritize the review.

Sara: Can you paste the minimal repro or the failing log? I want to sanity-check the patch.

Kevin: Repro in the original issue thread, but main change is a null-check and a small cache key normalization. Snippet:

```
if (kv == null) {
  // guard: previous race when cache evicts mid-read
  return Optional.empty();
}
```

Alex: quick scan — looks fine, but left one comment about defensive cloning. Not a blocking concern.

CI-bot: Build #5102.1 passed (unit, integration). Security scan: pending. :white_check_mark: :hourglass:

Jess: I can give an approval after security scan completes. Queue me for final once it passes.

Tom: I reviewed the clone comment — it's harmless here, LGTM from me but can re-open if CI or sec flags.

Kevin: Thanks Tom. We still need one more explicit approver to meet the merge gate. Alex, once you resolve the comment are you able to push your approval?

Alex: Will resolve now and approve. FYI I re-ran a small local load test — no regressions.

Alex: Approved. :white_check_mark:

Jess: Security scan finished — no findings. Approving now.

Jess: Approved. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Merge checks satisfied for branch release/2.3.x. Auto-merge scheduled in 60s.

Kevin: Great — merging now. Please flag if anything odd appears post-merge.

Sara: Thanks team. I'll monitor the hotfix once deployed and verify the affected customer flows.

Kevin: Appreciate it. Note for release notes: mention fix for cache eviction NPE.

Tom: Nice work. :tada:

CI-bot: Deploy to staging started.

Kevin: Closing thread once staging smoke is green, otherwise I'll ping here.

CI-bot: Staging smoke passed.

Kevin: Merged and promoted to release. Closing — thank you all. :pray:
